input.task: src/slugify.mjs has a bug: `node --test` fails. Fix src/slugify.mjs so that all tests pass. A slug is lowercase, has no leading or trailing dashes, and joins each run of letters and digits with a single dash; every other character is a separator. Do not change the tests.

Add a method applyDiscount(code) to the Cart class in src/cart.mjs. 'SAVE10' takes 10% off the subtotal. 'FLAT5' takes 5 off the subtotal, but the total never goes below 0. Any other code throws an Error. Applying a code replaces any earlier code. total() keeps rounding to cents. Keep the existing tests passing, and add tests for applyDiscount to test/cart.test.mjs.

parseCsv in src/csv.mjs splits naively. Make it handle quoted fields: a quoted field may contain commas, newlines and doubled quotes ("" stands for one quote). Accept both 
 and 
 line ends and ignore one final trailing line end. Fields are strings; an empty field is ''. Add test/csv.test.mjs with node:test tests for parseCsv and make `node --test` pass.

listItems in src/api.mjs returns the wrong pages, and `node --test` fails. The bugs are in more than one file (src/api.mjs and src/paginate.mjs). Rules: pages count from 1, so page 1 holds the first pageSize items. pageCount(total, pageSize) in src/paginate.mjs is the number of pages needed for all items (0 for an empty list), and pageRange(page, pageSize) is the slice bounds { start, end } of one page (end is exclusive). listItems returns { items, page, pages, hasNext }: pages is the page count, hasNext is true only when a later page exists, and a page below 1 or not a whole number counts as page 1 (the returned page is the one used). A page past the last page gives an empty items array and hasNext false. Fix the code so that all tests pass and the rules hold. Do not change the tests.

Add expiry to the Cache class in src/cache.mjs and use it in src/loader.mjs. `new Cache({ ttlMs = Infinity, now = Date.now } = {})` takes a time to live in milliseconds and a clock function (tests pass a fake clock). `set(key, value, ttlMs)` stores a value; its optional third argument replaces the cache's ttlMs for that entry (Infinity means never expires). An entry set at time t expires at t + ttl and counts as expired when now() >= t + ttl, so a ttl of 0 expires at once. Setting a key again restarts its time. get, has and size() ignore expired entries (size() counts live entries only); get on an expired key returns undefined and also removes that entry. Add purge(), which removes every expired entry and returns how many it removed. Values such as 0 and '' are real values. Without options a cache never expires, and the existing behaviour stays. Change createLoader in src/loader.mjs to `createLoader(load, { ttlMs, now } = {})` so that its cache uses those options and loader.get(key) calls load again after the cached value has expired. Keep the existing tests passing, and add tests for expiry to test/cache.test.mjs (use a fake clock, not real waiting).

The booking code in src/range.mjs and src/bookings.mjs has bugs, and `node --test` fails. Rules: a stay occupies the nights from check-in up to but not including check-out, so a stay that ends on 2024-03-05 and a stay that starts on 2024-03-05 do not overlap. nights(stay) is the number of nights. overlaps(a, b) is true when two stays share at least one night. findConflicts(bookings, request) returns the bookings of the same room that overlap the request, in input order; a booking with status 'cancelled' never conflicts. totalNights(bookings, room) adds up the nights of the room's bookings, without cancelled ones. canBook(bookings, request) is false when the request has conflicts, and also false when its check-out is not after its check-in. Fix the code so that all tests pass and the rules hold. Do not change the tests.
